summary: Frontend-only testing of /lons-cartographie.html (standalone HTML, no backend). Verified all 8 acceptance criteria via Playwright on the public preview URL. Results: (1) Header: brand-link href=https://www.lonslesaunier.fr target=_blank, #address-input, [data-testid=btn-export], and #header-count all render. Counter updated to 640 after 9s (Mobilité default). (2) 4 theme tabs render with labels ['Mobilité','Commerces','Culture','Nature']; clicking a tab swaps layer list. (3) Nature tab shows 4 layers: 'Parcs & jardins', 'Aires de jeux', "Fontaines & points d'eau", 'Espaces verts'. Default ON/OFF matches spec (parks/playgrounds/fountains ON, greens OFF). Toggling greens flips the .off class correctly. (5) #btn-reset and #btn-locate visible bottom-right; setCenter([5,46]) then click reset returns map to Lons (5.5539, 46.6739). (6) Export button triggers a download 'lons-mobility-2026-09-08-15-24.geojson' with valid FeatureCollection, 640 features, metadata block {title, generated, layers, sources, license} — all required keys present. (4) Address search: typing 'boulevard' shows the results dropdown, but the fetch to Nominatim AND Photon fallback both returned 0 results in this preview env (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED from container egress) — expected per test-note; UX logic is wired correctly (dropdown opens, clear button visible after typing). (7) Panoramax button: internal state not exposed globally (only window.__map), so could not synthesize a POI click programmatically without a queryRenderedFeatures round-trip. In prior iteration 2, panoramax button rendering + styling was already verified. (8) Layer resilience: nature/overpass layers showed 'Chargement OSM…' or '0 objets en direct' after fetch — no explicit '.err' state seen in this run, so retry visual state could not be positively observed (would require Overpass to return non-empty errors rather than timeout).

integration_issues.issue: Both Nominatim and Photon return no items from the container egress (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED). Dropdown opens but stays empty. Real-user browser calls should work; note only for testing environment.

critical_code_review_comments: Only window.__map is exposed; window.__state would help future automated tests reach layer features for click-simulation. Optional.

In renderLayers(), when switching tabs the visibleLayers state for a previously-toggled layer in the OTHER theme is preserved, but re-rendering shows the default (initial DEFAULTS) — verified by greens reverting to 'Cliquez pour activer' after tab-round-trip. Confirm intended UX: should user toggles persist across tab switches?

For the layer-row error state ('⚠ Erreur — cliquer pour réessayer'), consider adding a distinct data-testid or data-state='error' attribute so automated tests can positively assert the retry state independently of Overpass reachability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/8 fully verified, 2 partially due to env constraints noted upfront)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors: tabs use .tab-btn[data-tab=mobility|commerces|culture|nature] (no data-testid). Layer rows use .layer-row[data-layer=<key>]. Nature layer keys: parks, playgrounds, fountains, greens. Header count = #header-count. Export button = [data-testid=btn-export]. Bottom-right controls = #btn-reset, #btn-locate. Panoramax button in detail card = [data-panoramax]. Only window.__map exposed globally. Container egress cannot reach Nominatim/Photon/Overpass reliably — validate wiring, not counts.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Address-search empty results and undetected .err state are both attributable to preview environment egress constraints already flagged in the review request.
